Body.Content:
With improved Copilot file skills in OneDrive, you can go from files to finished work directly from chat. Copilot helps you find the right content, analyze files and data, create polished outputs like summaries, dashboards, and presentations, and collaborate by saving or sharing the results from OneDrive.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: August CY2026
